judgments.note: Military cues and the inspection relation are directly observable; belonging to the internet genre is a semantic inference and will be labeled as such.
A table surrounded by a dinghy tube is observable. Grounding/support may be concealed by the water/tube; if pixels do not show the complete required relation, this authorial gate cannot pass.
A hidden grip or obscured mop-head/floor junction is partial, even if a mop-like object and salute are visible.
Facial similarity is assessed only at actual output resolution; the short bob alone does not establish face fidelity or identity.
Visible orientation and props may support an inspection scene. Spoken orders, rank-based coercion, history and consent will not be inferred from still pixels.

decision: Keep the frozen testcase unchanged; accept a strict failure if a consequential connection is hidden.
